text: Binary per-post check on other users' comments (OC_comments, a JSON list to parse), judged against the OP's view from title and argument (context only). Returns 1 if at least one comment opens by directly contradicting or rejecting the OP's view as a whole, in general blanket disagreement not limited to a narrow part, without first explicitly acknowledging any validity in the OP's view. Returns 0 if the list is valid but empty, or no comment does this, including comments that acknowledge validity first or only raise narrow caveats. Ignores OP text announcing a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title or argument is missing so the target can't be determined. List order carries no chronology or rank.
